title: Base Substitution Analysis and Redox-State Framework
summary: This cluster revolves around Genome-Wide Base Substitution Analysis, a process that involves various base substitutions, including C > A, C > G, C > T, and G > A. These substitutions are associated with both High DO and Low DO methods or tools. High DO is enriched in detoxification, oxidoreductase activity, and redox-buffering-associated pathways, while Low DO is linked to cytoplasmic translation, protein synthesis, and ribosome biogenesis. The cluster also includes methods for measuring intracellular ROS and its effects on antioxidant enzyme activity and mixed transcriptome-fidelity response models.
